requirement_summary: Duplicate carrier, bandwidth, numerology, channel, mobility, RF, and capture settings must be audited with explicit precedence and conflict reporting.
independent_reference: independent readback of scenario YAML and resolved struct values

clause: CDL/TDL channel model; OFDM resource grid
requirement_summary: Concrete fading profiles such as CDL-C or TDL-C must remain distinct from AWGN and must not use scalar full-grid channel estimates.
independent_reference: MATLAB 5G Toolbox CDL/TDL references and no-oracle negative trials

requirement_summary: Configured UE trajectories must be converted into route length, traversal time, required slots, and inter-UE distance constraints before claiming a full mobility study.
CFO, phase noise, timing offset, IQ imbalance, PA nonlinearity, EVM, and PAPR must be configured-vs-applied and reconciled from waveform evidence before Phase7Ok can pass.
independent_reference: before/after waveform hashes and independent impairment injection checks

requirement_summary: Throughput, BLER, BER, latency, access, scheduler, mobility, MIMO, and energy KPIs must cite raw runtime rows and confidence intervals rather than summary-only or fallback rows.
independent_reference: independent recomputation from public CSV rows

requirement_summary: Pilot, final, stress, sensitivity, and edge-case campaigns must publish seed/drop counts, confidence intervals, failed-run accounting, and adequacy decisions.
independent_reference: independent binomial and bootstrap confidence interval checks

requirement_summary: Final reports, claims matrix, defect register, provenance, plot lineage, and source-diff pointers must be emitted without promoting missing evidence to publication readiness.
Phase7Ok, ResultOk, and PublicationReadinessOk are true only when every required evidence gate is explicitly true and prior phase gates also pass.
